sloka: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य दुह्खिता ।प्रसक्त अश्रु मुखी मन्दम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२९-१॥
transliteration: etat tu vacanam śrutvā sītā rāmasya duhkhitā ।prasakta aśru mukhī mandam idam vacanam abravīt ॥2-29-1॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Rama, thus spoke Sita in a faint voice in sadness, with tears flowing incessantly from her eyes:
